title: Generative AI Designs De Novo pMHC Minibinders Turning Human T Cells into Precision Cancer Killers
aiTimeToSolve: Weeks (vs. years for patient TCR isolation)
whyItMatters: Published in Science: uses RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and AlphaFold 2 to design precision minibinders against intracellular cancer pMHC neoantigens in weeks—driving CAR-T killing of melanoma cells.
summary: Researchers from the Technical University of Denmark and The Scripps Research Institute published a generative de novo minibinder platform in Science that replaces years-long patient T-cell receptor (TCR) screening with computational design in weeks. Combining RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, AlphaFold 2, and in silico cross-reactivity screening, the team engineered high-affinity minibinders targeting the intracellular cancer antigen complex NY-ESO-1/HLA-A*02:01 (confirmed by cryo-EM) as well as a tumor neoantigen pMHC of unknown experimental structure; engineered into chimeric antigen receptors on human T cells, the AI-designed binders triggered potent, selective killing of melanoma cells.
technicalHighlights: Uses RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and AlphaFold 2 with in silico cross-panning to engineer specific binders for hard-to-target intracellular cancer pMHC complexes.
Confirmed atomic-level binding accuracy of the NY-ESO-1 cancer minibinder via cryo-electron microscopy.
Arming human T cells with the AI-designed binders induced selective melanoma cell killing and generalized to a tumor neoantigen with no prior solved crystal structure.
caveats: Validated in cryo-EM and human cancer cell-killing assays in vitro; in vivo tumor clearance, off-target tissue safety, and human clinical trials remain future milestones.

scoreRationale.foundational: Cracks the longstanding challenge of targeting intracellular cancer neoantigens presented on MHC molecules using de novo AI-designed binders.
scoreRationale.ripple: Paves the way for rapid, patient-specific personalized T-cell cancer immunotherapies across solid tumors.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science (Jul 24, 2025) with cryo-EM structure confirmation and functional T-cell cytotoxicity assays against melanoma.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compresses therapeutic receptor discovery for patient neoantigens from years of wet-lab screening down to weeks.

sources.label: Johansen, Hadrup, Jenkins et al. — De novo-designed pMHC binders facilitate T cell-mediated cytotoxicity toward cancer cells (Science, 2025)
